description: For flooring installation, this issue tracking log records layout, acclimation, substrate preparation, moisture limits, adhesive, expansion, sequencing, and protection. use_case: Use the issue tracking log during flooring installation readiness and acceptance when the flooring installation record must identify room, substrate, flooring product and lot, transitions, moisture-sensitive areas, furniture, and adjacent finishes. Complete the applicable handoff for finish inspection, protection plan, care instructions, attic-stock handoff, warranty, and customer acceptance.
